title: Generative AI and Extended Reality in Collaborative Architectural Design Education: An Exploratory Studio Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.13494v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Architectural design education relies heavily on visual ideation and representation to support collaborative learning in studio environments. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and extended reality (XR) offer new opportunities for rapid idea exploration and immersive spatial visualization. This exploratory mixed-methods classroom study investigated how GenAI-assisted multi-user XR influenced collaborative architectural conceptual design. We developed GenARch, a pipeline that integrates GenAI-based visual generation with collaborative XR environments, and deployed it in an undergraduate architectural design studio. Twenty-seven students formed seven self-selected design teams; four teams incorporated GenARch into their usual course workflow to support collaborative ideation and visualization, while three teams continued the same course workflow without GenARch. translated_title: 生成式人工智能与扩展现实在协作式建筑设计教育中的应用：一项探索性设计工作室研究
translated_abstract: 建筑设计教育在很大程度上依赖视觉构思与表达，以支持设计工作室环境中的协作学习。生成式人工智能与扩展现实的最新进展为快速的创意探索和沉浸式空间可视化提供了新的机遇。本探索性混合方法课堂研究考察了生成式AI辅助的多用户XR如何影响协作式建筑概念设计。我们开发了GenARch——一个将基于生成式AI的视觉生成与协作式XR环境相整合的工作流程，并将其部署于本科建筑设计工作室课程中。二十七名学生组成了七个自主选择的设计团队；其中四个团队将GenARch融入其常规课程工作流程，以支持协作式构思与可视化，另外三个团队则在未使用GenARch的情况下延续相同的课程工作流程。干预前后的问卷调查评估了设计……
tldr: 该研究开发了GenARch——一个将生成式AI视觉生成能力与协作式扩展现实环境相整合的工作流程，并在本科建筑设计工作室中验证了其对协作式概念设计与可视化的支持作用。
en_tdlr: This study developed GenARch, a pipeline integrating GenAI-based visual generation with collaborative XR environments, and explored its impact on collaborative conceptual design in an undergraduate architectural design studio.
